messages:
maria: Quick ping 1 — putting together the SEO preflight for the April launch (webinar + launch post). I dropped a living checklist in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Can people scan and call out gaps? :spiral_notepad:

james: on it. top-level needs: intent buckets, SERP tracking seeds, JSON-LD for the event + speakers, canonical & redirect rules, internal link plan, meta copy variations for A/B testing.

olivia: Event + FAQ schema needed. I'll author a compact JSON-LD we can paste into <head>. Also suggest we include Action for registration (potentially helps discovery).

leo: internal linking note: aim for 2-3 contextual links from docs (authored by product) and at least one feature blog to the landing. use mixed anchor types  (brand, long-tail, verb phrases). I'll export a CSV mapping soon.

sara: redirect inventory: I found /resources/wip-launch and /events/old-demo pointing to the old page. Propose 301 -> /webinar/launch-apr-2026. Also confirm server-level vs next.js rewrites.

james: keyword seeds draft (grouped by intent):
- info: "llm inference benchmarks", "batching for inference"
- commercial: "hosted llm inference api", "dedicated inference capacity"
- webinar-specific: "llm serving webinar", "redwood inference live demo"
Use webinar-specific phrases in H1 + meta desc. Keep meta under 160 chars.

olivia: JSON-LD (minimal Event + FAQ)  paste into head, replace placeholders:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar" },
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" },
  "performer": [{ "@type": "Person", "name": "Avery Chen" }],
  "description": "Demo + benchmark narrative: production LLM serving patterns."
}
```

olivia: FAQ snippet (example) to include on page for rich result:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    { "@type": "Question", "name": "Who should attend?", "acceptedAnswer": { "@type": "Answer", "text": "Engineers and infra teams working on LLM serving." } }
  ]
}
```

leo: internal link CSV example rows:
`/docs/guide,production inference patterns,/webinar/launch-apr-2026`
`/blog/benchmarks,llm benchmarks,/webinar/launch-apr-2026`
I'll attach full CSV to the doc.

sara: redirect examples (nginx / next.js):
```
# nginx 301 rule:
rewrite ^/resources/wip-launch$ /webinar/launch-apr-2026 permanent;
# next.js route: { source: '/resources/wip-launch', destination: '/webinar/launch-apr-2026', permanent: true }
```

maria: small SEO config asks:
- include <link rel=\"canonical\"> without querystrings (keep utm for analytics)
- meta robots OK (index, follow)
- meta open graph + twitter card (image sizes)
Can someone add meta copy variants for A/B test?

james: I'll draft 3 meta descriptions + 3 H2 variations tied to the keyword buckets. also setting up SERP tracking for the top 12 seeds and a lightweight eval set for quality in Redwood Optimize. baseline run scheduled today.

olivia: quick CTA accessibility check: ensure the register button has aria-label and visible text; include schema 'potentialAction' if applicable.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Publishing window is 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC. Please run checklist 24h prior. :white_check_mark:

maria: Action owners: james -> keywords, meta variants, SERP seeds + eval set; olivia -> final JSON-LD + FAQ + accessibility check; leo -> internal link CSV; sara -> redirect PR + server rewrite check. I'll mark owners in the doc and set a triage review 2026-04-09. Thanks team :rocket:
